entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The angelic-sounding voices of a bo..."
entries.dialogueText: The angelic-sounding voices of a boys' choir echoed through the Great Hall of Palas Rezna.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "To most Rizians, this was the grand..."
entries.dialogueText: To most Rizians, this was the grandest room in the grandest building in the entire country. To me, it was just home.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I remembered playing hide-and-seek..."
entries.dialogueText: I remembered playing hide-and-seek among the mosaic-tiled columns while visiting my grandmother. Goofing off with Pabel in the upper gallery as my father met with foreign dignitaries.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I remembered playing hide-and-seek..."
entries.dialogueText: I remembered playing hide-and-seek among the mosaic-tiled columns while visiting my grandmother. Watching from the upper gallery as my father met with foreign dignitaries.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And of course, this was where I had..."
entries.dialogueText: And of course, this was where I had married Lena...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The hall before me was filled with..."
entries.dialogueText: The hall before me was filled with nobles, politicians, business magnates, even movie stars. A television crew moved up and down the aisles, broadcasting the ceremony to the Rizian public for the first time.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother was sitting in the front..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother was sitting in the front row next to Uncle Hugo.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Tradition dictated that in the abse..."
entries.dialogueText: Tradition dictated that in the absence of a king or queen consort, the seat next to me would be filled by the successor to the throne. Vina plucked at a stray thread in her gown.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ready for the next chapter.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ready for the next chapter."
entries.menuText: "Ready for the next chapter."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""How are you feeling, Father?""
entries.dialogueText: "How are you feeling, Father?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My feelings are none of your busin..."
entries.dialogueText: "My feelings are none of your business."
entries.menuText: "My feelings are none of your business."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Shh. Stop fidgeting. The cameras a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Shh. Stop fidgeting. The cameras are on us."
entries.menuText: "Shh. Stop fidgeting. The cameras are on us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Honestly? A little nervous.""
entries.dialogueText: "Honestly? A little nervous."
entries.menuText: "Honestly? A little nervous."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The final notes of the coronation h..."
entries.dialogueText: The final notes of the coronation hymn "By His Sword I Live" rang out. An expectant silence filled the hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was broken by the sound of shuff..."
entries.dialogueText: It was broken by the sound of shuffling footsteps. The cameras followed Grand Wiseman Sal Ignacius as he walked slowly down the central aisle, bearing a velvet cushion.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He presented it in front of me. On..."
entries.dialogueText: He presented it in front of me. On it was the Toras crown, a black onyx orb and a scroll containing the words to the royal oath.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I took the scroll off the cushion a..."
entries.dialogueText: I took the scroll off the cushion and read aloud from it.
entries.menuText: Recite the oath.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I lifted the orb off the cushion an..."
entries.dialogueText: I lifted the orb off the cushion and ran my fingers across its smooth surface.
entries.menuText: Take the orb.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I caught my mother's eye. She gave..."
entries.dialogueText: I caught my mother's eye. She gave me a conspiratorial wink.
entries.menuText: Look at Estela.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I gazed at the Toras crown, forged..."
entries.dialogueText: I gazed at the Toras crown, forged when my family took the throne almost 150 years ago.
entries.menuText: Look at the crown.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hereby pledge myself in service..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hereby pledge myself in service to the great nation of Rizia and its people."
entries.menuText: "I hereby pledge myself..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I promise to guide my country with..."
entries.dialogueText: "I promise to guide my country with a steadfast hand."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To uphold the laws of this land un..."
entries.dialogueText: "To uphold the laws of this land under St. Wruhec's watchful eye."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To wield the sword of justice and..."
entries.dialogueText: "To wield the sword of justice and the shield of mercy in equal measure."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All this I shall do until the day..."
entries.dialogueText: "All this I shall do until the day I die."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With trembling hands, Grand Wiseman..."
entries.dialogueText: With trembling hands, Grand Wiseman Ignacius lifted the crown off the cushion.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could spot a grey hair still clin..."
entries.dialogueText: I could spot a grey hair still clinging to its inner rim. My father's.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crown came down on my head. Its..."
entries.dialogueText: The crown came down on my head. Its heaviness surprised me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stood. The choir broke into "On S..."
entries.dialogueText: I stood. The choir broke into "On Shores of Gold," the Rizian national anthem.
entries.menuText: Stand up.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I held up my hand for silence. The..."
entries.dialogueText: I held up my hand for silence. The choir stopped singing. Confused whispers ran through the crowd.
entries.menuText: Break tradition and make a speech first.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I hoped my limp wasn't visible to t..."
entries.dialogueText: I hoped my limp wasn't visible to television viewers. I thought about the kidnapper's bullet and how close I had come to never seeing this day.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We reached the end of the hall, whe..."
entries.dialogueText: We reached the end of the hall, where a spiral staircase led to the palace balcony.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've got to do this part alone.""
entries.dialogueText: "I've got to do this part alone."
entries.menuText: "I've got to do this part alone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Come, Vina, let's greet your futur..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come, Vina, let's greet your future subjects."
entries.menuText: "Come, Vina, let's greet your future subjects."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know this is highly unusual, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know this is highly unusual, but we are living in unusual times."
entries.menuText: "I know this is highly unusual, but we are living in unusual times."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ladies and gentlemen of Rizia...""
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and gentlemen of Rizia..."
entries.menuText: "Ladies and gentlemen of Rizia..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Uncle Hugo had been smiling proudly..."
entries.dialogueText: Uncle Hugo had been smiling proudly up to this point. His expression now grew serious.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When my father died, I made a prom..."
entries.dialogueText: "When my father died, I made a promise. One that I would like to share with you today."
entries.menuText: "When my father died, I made a promise. One that I would like to share with you all today."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My father was a great but flawed m..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father was a great but flawed man. His mistakes will not be repeated."
entries.menuText: "My father was a great but flawed man. His mistakes will not be repeated."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The reign of Valero Toras is over...."
entries.dialogueText: "The reign of Valero Toras is over. A new day has dawned in this country."
entries.menuText: "The reign of Valero Toras is over. A new day has dawned."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Under my rule, Rizia will be trans..."
entries.dialogueText: "Under my rule, Rizia will be transformed."
entries.menuText: "Under my rule, Rizia will be transformed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will succeed where our previous..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will succeed where our previous king failed."
entries.menuText: "I will succeed where our previous king failed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is time to show all of Merkopa..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is time to show all of Merkopa what Rizia is capable of."
entries.menuText: "It is time to show all of Merkopa what Rizia is capable of."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We must break with tradition and e..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must break with tradition and enter the 20th century."
entries.menuText: "We must break with tradition and enter the 20th century."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will uphold the monarchy and res..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will uphold the monarchy and restore the glory days of House Toras."
entries.menuText: "I will uphold the monarchy and restore the glory days of House Toras."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I promise I will take back the lan..."
entries.dialogueText: "I promise I will take back the lands that have been stolen from us."
entries.menuText: "I promise I will take back the lands that have been stolen from us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo's stare intensified."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo's stare intensified.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo's expression relaxed. He smile..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo's expression relaxed. He smiled.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Only when Rizia is once again whol..."
entries.dialogueText: "Only when Rizia is once again whole can a new era of peace and prosperity begin."
entries.menuText: "Only when Rizia is once again whole can a new era of peace and prosperity begin."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Only by achieving harmony with our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Only by achieving harmony with our neighbors can a new era begin."
entries.menuText: "Only by achieving harmony with our neighbors can a new era begin."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Only once Rizia is united under a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Only once Rizia is united under a strong king can a new era begin."
entries.menuText: "Only once Rizia is united under a strong king can a new era begin."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A new era begins now.""
entries.dialogueText: "A new era begins now."
entries.menuText: "A new era begins now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you all.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you all."
entries.menuText: "Thank you all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Long live House Toras.""
entries.dialogueText: "Long live House Toras."
entries.menuText: "Long live House Toras."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Glovurius axa Rizia.""
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia."
entries.menuText: "Glovurius axa Rizia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The hall fell silent again. My uncl..."
entries.dialogueText: The hall fell silent again. My uncle was the first to speak.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Glovurius axa Rizia!""
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The attendees hurriedly broke into..."
entries.dialogueText: The attendees hurriedly broke into enthusiastic applause. The choir restarted the national anthem.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My daughter beamed and put her arm..."
entries.dialogueText: My daughter beamed and put her arm through mine. We walked up and up the stairs until we came to a door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leaving Vina behind, I walked up an..."
entries.dialogueText: Leaving Vina behind, I walked up and up the stairs until I came to a door.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stepped out onto the balcony. The..."
entries.dialogueText: I stepped out onto the balcony. The sunlight was so dazzling I was almost blinded.
entries.menuText: Open it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When my eyes adjusted, I regarded t..."
entries.dialogueText: When my eyes adjusted, I regarded the scene below me. Thousands and thousands of people were packed onto the palace grounds, some waving the Rizian flag, others the House Toras banner.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Just beyond them, at the gates, the..."
entries.dialogueText: Just beyond them, at the gates, the police easily held back a small pocket of protesters.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I paid little attention to them. I..."
entries.dialogueText: I paid little attention to them. I was focused on the noise of the crowd, an overwhelming roar that gradually cohered into a single chant: "Salutenas axa regu novus!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All hail the new king."
entries.dialogueText: All hail the new king.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We must stop letting our past grud..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must stop letting our past grudges dictate our future."
entries.menuText: "We must stop letting our past grudges dictate our future."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I sat upright in the Sila Orica, th..."
entries.dialogueText: I sat upright in the Sila Orica, the gold-plated wooden throne on which all monarchs of Rizia were coronated.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""May St. Wruhec fill you with his h..."
entries.dialogueText: "May St. Wruhec fill you with his holy spirit on this day, as he did your ancestors before you."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""May you keep the promises you have..."
entries.dialogueText: "May you keep the promises you have made before God and your people."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""By the divine power vested in me,..."
entries.dialogueText: "By the divine power vested in me, I proclaim you sovereign king of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I decided to proceed without making..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to proceed without making a speech.
entries.menuText: Proceed with the coronation.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Arise, King Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "Arise, King Romus."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Uncle Hugo had been smiling politel..."
entries.dialogueText: Uncle Hugo had been smiling politely up to this point. His expression now grew serious.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I remembered wandering between the..."
entries.dialogueText: I remembered wandering between the mosaic-tiled columns as a bored teenager. Goofing off with Pabel in the upper gallery as my father met with foreign dignitaries.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I remembered wandering between the..."
entries.dialogueText: I remembered wandering between the mosaic-tiled columns as a bored teenager. Watching from the upper gallery as my father met with foreign dignitaries.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Only when the people of Rizia are..."
entries.dialogueText: "Only when the people of Rizia are given a voice can a new era begin."
entries.menuText: "Only when the people of Rizia are given a voice can a new era begin."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Don't worry, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry, Father."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My daughter smiled."
entries.dialogueText: My daughter smiled.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Me, too. I wish Mother was the one..."
entries.dialogueText: "Me, too. I wish Mother was the one sitting here, though."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My daughter smiled."
entries.dialogueText: My daughter smiled.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Sorry!""
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My daughter sat up straight and fol..."
entries.dialogueText: My daughter sat up straight and folded her hands in her lap.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My daughter seemed to shrink in her..."
entries.dialogueText: My daughter seemed to shrink in her chair.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You're right, Father. Sorry.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're right, Father. Sorry."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The ceremonial robes I was wearing..."
entries.dialogueText: The ceremonial robes I was wearing chafed against the scar on my shoulder. I thought about the kidnapper's bullet and how close I had come to never seeing this day.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You are the king now.""
entries.dialogueText: "You are the king now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was made of pure gold, adorned w..."
entries.dialogueText: It was made of pure gold, adorned with two twisting spires resembling bull's horns.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was inlaid with a trio of diamon..."
entries.dialogueText: It was inlaid with a trio of diamonds, representing the three royal houses of Rizia: Toras, Azaro and Sazon.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May God bless this country and its..."
entries.dialogueText: "May God bless this country and its people."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Glory to Rizia. His shout reverbera..."
entries.dialogueText: Glory to Rizia. His shout reverberated throughout the hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone in the crowd bowed their h..."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone in the crowd bowed their heads as Vina and I made our way down the aisle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I passed my cousin Rico in the seco..."
entries.dialogueText: I passed my cousin Rico in the second row. He looked up at me and smiled.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I passed my cousin Rico in the seco..."
entries.dialogueText: I passed my cousin Rico in the second row. He kept his head down and didn't acknowledge me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The entire back row was reserved fo..."
entries.dialogueText: The entire back row was reserved for the Rumburgian royal family and their entourage. I could feel my sister-in-law Beatrice's eyes on me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we kept walking, I recognized va..."
entries.dialogueText: As we kept walking, I recognized various other members of Rizia's three royal houses as well as monarchs from distant kingdoms.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "According to royal tradition, this..."
entries.dialogueText: According to royal tradition, this was my signal to march down the aisle and up to the palace balcony to greet the public.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
